Sorry you won't be able to make it Jeff, but Comic Carnival really is on Monday evening.

Tim at Comic Carnival has been a good friend to Sentinels, so it wasn't fun to have to ask him if he was willing to have it on a non-weekend time. The reality, though, is that weekends are the best time for almost all of the stores, doing events back to back is really draining, and the game stores are simply a bigger draw than a comic store.

We're going to try Monday night this time around. If it's a bust, we'll have to find something better next time.

posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
Three sessions down, five to go.

 

Wed night was GP Bloomington and a very nice turnout. We had two games going simultaneously the whole time and got to see lots of familiar and new faces. I ran a five player games against the advanced Ennead. We lost, kinda badly, and it seemed to go on forever as the few remaining heroes tried to hold on, BUT I think everyone had a really good time.

 

Thu at noon we were at Downtown Comics. We had a few regulars stop by and only a couple of people we didn't know, so it was a bit of a bust from the standpoint of numbers of people. On the otherhand, as long as Christopher is here, since this is the one store that likes having us during the middle of the day, there's no reason not to set up there and the low numbers of people made it quite relaxing. We even got in a playtest game with some of the Shattered Timelines decks.

 

Thu evening was at Arsenal and there was a great turnout. Thu night is Arsenal's boardgame night. It's an excellent time to potentially catch the eye of players who may not yet know the game. On the other hand, we recognize that a lot of the regular boardgame night attendees are really looking forward to playing other games. That's not a problem as long as there is enough space, but last night space ended up at a premium. We managed to squeeze three full games onto the tables and had them all full most of the night.

 

Having had a ridiculously busy time at work over the last couple of weeks, my energy levels have been a bit off. I'm trying to be careful to get enough sleep so I can really enjoy the next few days -- and FIVE more game days at stores?!?!
